setup: Explicit user preparation can focus the agent window once. The fixture then simulates returning to the human window; automatic resume happens before measured typing/work.
scope: Owned headful browser under Xvfb/X11 with Openbox. Concurrent OS-level xdotool typing and muted canvas-stream video in the human tab. Not Wayland/macOS/Windows, covered/minimized or a real personal-media session.

rows.name: native-form-work-alongside-real-X11-typing-and-media
rows.error: Human typing was changed or lost
